newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares surge past 900-points mark.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares surge past 900-points mark.

text.p: The Delhi Stock Exchange sensitive index crossed the psychological barrier of 900 points in early trade on Thursday as foreign investors and speculators made purchases in select blue chip companies, brokers said.
The bourse's benchmark index was 7.11 points higher at 900.52 after 30 minutes of trade.
"If the market is able to maintain the 900-point level then a further rise can be expected in coming sessions," said Manoj Choraria of brokers Choraria Investments.
Reliance Industries rose 3.15 rupees to 364.50 on speculative purchases triggered by reports that the company planned to increase foreign institutional investors' (FIIs) holdings.

The Economic Times reported on Thursday that Reliance Industries would seek its shareholders' approval at an extraordinary general meeting to increase the limit on FIIs' holdings to 30 percent from 24 percent. The newspaper did not say when the meeting would be held.
State Bank of India gained 1.50 rupees to 332.70.
Larsen and Toubro firmed 1.00 rupee to 270.00.
